author: HolisticGamer
quote: I bought this game so I could enjoy my time in an open world sand box driving and running and gunning, the graphics are nice but the fps drop is awful and now instead of an open world  there’s protected classes of people you cant fight, the flight mechanics are nerfed, and worst of all I’m stuck unable to interact with any female characters like the old GTA and have to do house chores and reply to lucia’s text messages and hear her complain to even progress past the first 10 hours of the game. If i wanted to spend my down time catering to a woman all day I would shut the game off grab my daily to do list.
